SELECT SUB_PROVIDER_ADDRESS_ID FROM SUB_PROVIDER_ADDRESS WHERE (RETIRED_DATE IS NULL OR RETIRED_DATE > SYSDATE)
AND ADDRESS LIKE #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND CITY LIKE #{city,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND STATE LIKE #{state,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND ZIPCODE LIKE #{zipcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND COUNTY_FIPS LIKE #{countyFips,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND PHONE LIKE #{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
